title: A Recursive Characterization of Laplacian Spectral Radii of Trees with Bounded Maximum Degree
summary: For a positive integer $r$ and a real number $α\ge 2$, let $\mathscr L_r(α)$ be the set of positive real numbers containing $α-1$ and closed under the following operation: if $q_1,\ldots,q_s\in\mathscr L_r(α)$, where $1\leq s\leq r-1$, and $q=α-1-s-\sum\limits_{i=1}^{s}q_i^{-1}>0$, then $q\in\mathscr L_r(α)$. We prove that there exists a tree $T$ with $Δ(T)\leq r$ and Laplacian spectral radius $μ(T)=α$ if and only if $(α-1)^{-1}\in\mathscr L_r(α)$.
